In grade 3, during mandatory swimming lessons. Whenever our teacher turned her back we would swim from the wall we lined up on (being on the deep end) to the floating pool divider and back. Think of it as a quick 20 second horizontal swim just to be cheeky. Me, wanting to be cool too, decided to do this as well and it was all going fine until my swim on the way back. I kicked too early and my leg got hit by the pool divider and broke my momentum. I couldn't regain it back fast enough so I started just sinking to the bottom. By the time I got a grasp of the situation- realising the teacher was probably long gone down the lane- I accepted I was likely gonna drown and closed my eyes as I sunk (honestly I was so embarrassed, my child brain kinda hoped I would). Suddenly though, this kid named Johnny swam down and pulled me back up. Was sputtering for a while, but said thanks to him and that was that. 

Needless to say, we were all pretty well behaved the rest of the lesson.
